conf.description: cisco-asa acl-deny dataset, syslog-raw format (106023/106100/106015/106021 ACL and security-check denies): parsing is deferred entirely to the Elastic cisco_asa integration (106023 via grok, 106100 via dissect). This pipeline is intentionally thin: it only tags event.dataset and passes _raw through untouched.

conf.comment: cisco-asa / acl-deny / syslog-raw: the 106xxx deny family. 106023 and 106100 share almost no token layout, so a detection cannot assume one field set across the family -- which is exactly why the map defers this to the integration's per-message-ID patterns rather than a single Cribl grok. Do NOT re-parse acl_ID, protocol, sockets, outcome, hit-cnt, or the TrustSec/ICMP customs here. The field-table's only transforms (message_id lookup, permitted/denied/est-allowed outcome translation) both require a field already extracted from the body, so neither is safely implementable pre-parse.

functions.description: document why this pipeline does not parse _raw
tag the event with its dataset ahead of the Elastic integration's own parsing of _raw
